spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m1p4t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS N, CAP

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 2 /\ CAP \in Nat /\ CAP >= 1

Cranes == 1 .. N
succ(c) == (c % N) + 1
Ids == 0 .. CAP

VARIABLES holder, dest, yard, pending

vars == <<holder, dest, yard, pending>>

Init ==
    /\ holder = 1
    /\ dest = 1
    /\ yard = 0
    /\ pending = {}

\* Holder crane reserves one placement slot; the exclusive token means only
\* the holder may commit new work, and it must respect remaining headroom.
Reserve(c) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ yard + Cardinality(pending) < CAP
    /\ \E i \in Ids \ pending :
           pending' = pending \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, dest, yard>>

\* A reserved placement lands in the yard; the network may deliver these in
\* any order, so any currently-pending id can commit next.
Commit(i) ==
    /\ i \in pending
    /\ pending' = pending \ {i}
    /\ yard' = yard + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, dest>>

\* A container is unloaded, freeing a slot again.
Unload ==
    /\ yard > 0
    /\ yard' = yard - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, dest, pending>>

\* The holder hands the token to the next crane on the ring; it is now in
\* transit and no crane holds it.
Pass(c) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ holder' = 0
    /\ dest' = succ(c)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<yard, pending>>

\* The token in transit arrives at its destination crane.
Recv ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ holder' = dest
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dest, yard, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Reserve(c) \/ Pass(c)
    \/ \E i \in pending : Commit(i)
    \/ Unload
    \/ Recv

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Committed containers plus placements still in flight never overrun the yard.
Capacity == yard + Cardinality(pending) <= CAP
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    CAP = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Capacity
nl:
A container-ship crane yard coordinates several quay cranes that load
containers into a shared holding yard of fixed capacity. Exclusive access to
begin new placements is granted by a single token that circulates around the
cranes in a ring: only the crane currently holding the token may reserve a
placement, and it must leave enough headroom for the containers it has already
committed but not yet set down. When the holder is done it passes the token to
the next crane on the ring, and while the token is in transit no crane holds
it. A reserved placement travels to the yard as a message, and because the yard
network can reorder messages, reserved placements may be set down in any order.
Containers are also unloaded over time, freeing slots for reuse.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of containers resting in the yard plus the number
of reserved placements still in flight never exceeds the yard's fixed capacity.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m2p2t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Lobbies, Seed, Chunk

anchor == CHOOSE x \in Lobbies : TRUE

VARIABLES phase, tally, offline, holding, roster, deal

vars == <<phase, tally, offline, holding, roster, deal>>

Ballots == {"blank", "accept", "reject"}

RECURSIVE FoldSum(_, _)
FoldSum(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET z == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[z] + FoldSum(f, S \ {z})

Grand == Cardinality(Lobbies) * Seed

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in {"open", "polling", "sealed", "voided"}
  /\ tally \in [Lobbies -> Ballots]
  /\ offline \subseteq Lobbies
  /\ holding \in 0..Grand
  /\ roster \in [Lobbies -> 0..Grand]
  /\ deal \in [src : Lobbies, dst : Lobbies]

Conserve == FoldSum(roster, Lobbies) + holding = Grand

Init ==
  /\ phase = "open"
  /\ tally = [l \in Lobbies |-> "blank"]
  /\ offline = {}
  /\ holding = 0
  /\ roster = [l \in Lobbies |-> Seed]
  /\ deal = [src |-> anchor, dst |-> anchor]

OpenDeal ==
  /\ phase = "open"
  /\ \E s, d \in Lobbies :
       /\ s # d
       /\ roster[s] >= Chunk
       /\ deal' = [src |-> s, dst |-> d]
       /\ roster' = [roster EXCEPT ![s] = @ - Chunk]
       /\ holding' = holding + Chunk
  /\ phase' = "polling"
  /\ tally' = [l \in Lobbies |-> "blank"]
  /\ UNCHANGED offline

CastAccept ==
  /\ phase = "polling"
  /\ \E l \in Lobbies :
       /\ l \notin offline
       /\ tally[l] = "blank"
       /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![l] = "accept"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, offline, holding, roster, deal>>

CastReject ==
  /\ phase = "polling"
  /\ \E l \in Lobbies :
       /\ l \notin offline
       /\ tally[l] = "blank"
       /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![l] = "reject"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, offline, holding, roster, deal>>

DropOut ==
  /\ phase \in {"open", "polling"}
  /\ \E l \in Lobbies :
       /\ l \notin offline
       /\ offline' = offline \cup {l}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, tally, holding, roster, deal>>

Seal ==
  /\ phase = "polling"
  /\ \A l \in Lobbies \ offline : tally[l] = "accept"
  /\ roster' = [roster EXCEPT ![deal.dst] = @ + holding]
  /\ holding' = 0
  /\ phase' = "sealed"
  /\ tally' = [l \in Lobbies |-> "blank"]
  /\ deal' = [src |-> anchor, dst |-> anchor]
  /\ UNCHANGED offline

Void ==
  /\ phase = "polling"
  /\ \E l \in Lobbies \ offline : tally[l] = "reject"
  /\ roster' = [roster EXCEPT ![deal.src] = @ + holding]
  /\ holding' = 0
  /\ phase' = "voided"
  /\ tally' = [l \in Lobbies |-> "blank"]
  /\ deal' = [src |-> anchor, dst |-> anchor]
  /\ UNCHANGED offline

Reopen ==
  /\ phase \in {"sealed", "voided"}
  /\ phase' = "open"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, offline, holding, roster, deal>>

Next ==
  \/ OpenDeal \/ CastAccept \/ CastReject
  \/ DropOut \/ Seal \/ Void \/ Reopen

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Lobbies = {a, b, c}
  Seed = 1
  Chunk = 1
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserve
nl:
In a multiplayer game lobby matchmaker, three lobby servers each begin holding a fixed
number of matchmaking credits. Credits are moved between lobbies through a two-phase
commit driven by a coordinator, and no credit is ever created or destroyed.

Actions:
- OpenDeal: while the coordinator is open, it selects a source lobby with enough credits
  and a distinct destination lobby, withdraws one credit chunk from the source into an
  escrow holding cell, records the proposed transfer, and moves to the polling phase with
  all ballots blanked.
- CastAccept: a lobby that is still online and has not yet voted casts an accept ballot.
- CastReject: a lobby that is still online and has not yet voted casts a reject ballot.
- DropOut: any online lobby silently crashes and goes offline, stopping its participation.
- Seal: when every still-online lobby has accepted, the coordinator commits, releasing the
  escrowed credit into the destination lobby, clearing escrow, and marking the deal sealed.
- Void: when any online lobby has rejected, the coordinator aborts, returning the escrowed
  credit to the source lobby, clearing escrow, and marking the deal voided.
- Reopen: after a sealed or voided deal, the coordinator returns to the open phase.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of matchmaking credits summed across all lobbies plus the escrow holding cell always equals the fixed grand total the system started with.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m3p5t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Cabins, Blocks, MaxTerm

VARIABLES epoch, master, powered, occupied, clearLog

vars == <<epoch, master, powered, occupied, clearLog>>

NoMaster == "vacant"

ImgLog == { clearLog[i] : i \in DOMAIN clearLog }

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ master \in Cabins \cup {NoMaster}
  /\ powered \subseteq Cabins
  /\ occupied \subseteq Blocks
  /\ clearLog \in Seq(Blocks)

\* A block is authorized to be occupied at most once for the whole history.
AtMostOnce ==
  \A i, j \in DOMAIN clearLog :
    clearLog[i] = clearLog[j] => i = j

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ master = NoMaster
  /\ powered = Cabins
  /\ occupied = {}
  /\ clearLog = << >>

Elect ==
  /\ master = NoMaster
  /\ \E c \in powered :
       /\ master' = c
       /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxTerm THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
  /\ UNCHANGED <<powered, occupied, clearLog>>

MasterFails ==
  /\ master # NoMaster
  /\ powered' = powered \ {master}
  /\ master' = NoMaster
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, occupied, clearLog>>

Recover ==
  /\ \E c \in Cabins \ powered :
       powered' = powered \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, master, occupied, clearLog>>

ClearBlock ==
  /\ master # NoMaster
  /\ \E b \in Blocks :
       /\ b \notin ImgLog
       /\ occupied' = occupied \cup {b}
       /\ clearLog' = Append(clearLog, b)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, master, powered>>

AdminOverride ==
  /\ \E b \in Blocks :
       /\ b \notin ImgLog
       /\ occupied' = occupied \cup {b}
       /\ clearLog' = Append(clearLog, b)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, master, powered>>

TrainExits ==
  /\ \E b \in occupied :
       occupied' = occupied \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, master, powered, clearLog>>

Next ==
  \/ Elect \/ MasterFails \/ Recover
  \/ ClearBlock \/ AdminOverride \/ TrainExits

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================
nl:
In a subway signalling block system, a set of trackside cabin controllers elects one master
controller that authorizes trains to enter track blocks. Authorizing a block for the first
time is irreversible, and the system tolerates master failover plus a privileged admin override.

Actions:
- Elect: when the master seat is vacant, a powered cabin becomes the new master; the epoch
  counter advances but saturates at its cap.
- MasterFails: the current master loses power, dropping out of the powered set and leaving
  the master seat vacant so a new election can occur.
- Recover: a cabin that had lost power is restored to the powered set.
- ClearBlock: the master authorizes a block that has never been authorized before, marking it
  occupied and appending it to the irreversible clearance log.
- AdminOverride: a privileged admin authorizes a never-before-authorized block directly,
  bypassing the master, marking it occupied and appending it to the clearance log.
- TrainExits: a train currently in a block leaves, clearing that block's occupancy while the
  clearance log is left untouched.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No track block ever appears more than once in the irreversible clearance log.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m4p2t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Machines, Coins, Cap

VARIABLES depot, staged, queued, shelved

vars == <<depot, staged, queued, shelved>>

RECURSIVE Tally(_)
Tally(g) ==
  LET dom == DOMAIN g IN
  IF dom = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET k == CHOOSE x \in dom : TRUE
       IN g[k] + Tally([ x \in dom \ {k} |-> g[x] ])

Queued == Tally(queued)
Shelved == Tally(shelved)

TypeOK ==
  /\ depot \in 0..Coins
  /\ staged \in 0..Coins
  /\ queued \in [Machines -> 0..Coins]
  /\ shelved \in [Machines -> 0..Coins]

\* Every restock token is somewhere: in the depot, staged, in the reorder
\* bag, or already on a machine shelf. None is minted or lost.
Conserved == depot + staged + Queued + Shelved = Coins

Init ==
  /\ depot = Coins
  /\ staged = 0
  /\ queued = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ shelved = [m \in Machines |-> 0]

Reserve ==
  /\ depot > 0
  /\ depot' = depot - 1
  /\ staged' = staged + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queued, shelved>>

Release ==
  /\ staged > 0
  /\ staged' = staged - 1
  /\ depot' = depot + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queued, shelved>>

Enqueue ==
  /\ staged > 0
  /\ Queued < Cap
  /\ \E m \in Machines :
       queued' = [queued EXCEPT ![m] = @ + 1]
  /\ staged' = staged - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<depot, shelved>>

Deliver ==
  /\ \E m \in Machines :
       /\ queued[m] > 0
       /\ queued' = [queued EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
       /\ shelved' = [shelved EXCEPT ![m] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<depot, staged>>

Recycle ==
  /\ \E m \in Machines :
       /\ shelved[m] > 0
       /\ shelved' = [shelved EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
  /\ depot' = depot + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<staged, queued>>

Next == Reserve \/ Release \/ Enqueue \/ Deliver \/ Recycle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Machines = {m1, m2}
  Coins = 3
  Cap = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
In a vending machine network, a central depot holds a fixed pool of restock tokens. Tokens flow
through a bounded reorder bag that applies backpressure before landing on individual machine
shelves. Because the reorder bag is order-free, pending deliveries may be serviced in any order.

Actions:
- Reserve: while the depot is non-empty, one token is pulled out of the depot into a staging cell.
- Release: a staged token that has not yet been enqueued is returned from staging back to the depot.
- Enqueue: a staged token is placed into the reorder bag for some machine, but only while the total
  number of pending items is below the bag's capacity, applying backpressure when full.
- Deliver: a pending item for any machine is removed from the reorder bag and placed on that
  machine's shelf, in any order relative to how items were enqueued.
- Recycle: a product on some machine's shelf is sold, and its slot token is returned to the depot
  so it can be reordered later.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of restock tokens across the depot, the staging cell, the reorder bag, and all machine shelves always equals the fixed pool size the network started with.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m6p1t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, MaxDeposit

VARIABLES ledgerBal, settled, leasing, snap, deposit, live

vars == <<ledgerBal, settled, leasing, snap, deposit, live>>

RECURSIVE SumSet(_)
SumSet(S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET b == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE
       IN deposit[b] + SumSet(S \ {b})

Cap == Cardinality(Banks) * MaxDeposit

TypeOK ==
  /\ ledgerBal \in 0..Cap
  /\ settled \subseteq Banks
  /\ leasing \subseteq Banks
  /\ snap \in [Banks -> 0..Cap]
  /\ deposit \in [Banks -> 0..MaxDeposit]
  /\ live \subseteq Banks

\* The shared ledger balance reflects exactly the deposits of every settled
\* bank -- no committed update was silently overwritten by a stale writer.
NoLostUpdate == ledgerBal = SumSet(settled)

Init ==
  /\ ledgerBal = 0
  /\ settled = {}
  /\ leasing = {}
  /\ snap = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ deposit = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ live = Banks

AcquireLease ==
  /\ \E b \in Banks, d \in 1..MaxDeposit :
       /\ b \in live
       /\ b \notin settled
       /\ b \notin leasing
       /\ leasing' = leasing \cup {b}
       /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![b] = ledgerBal]
       /\ deposit' = [deposit EXCEPT ![b] = d]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerBal, settled, live>>

LeaseExpires ==
  /\ \E b \in leasing :
       leasing' = leasing \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerBal, settled, snap, deposit, live>>

Commit ==
  /\ \E b \in leasing :
       /\ snap[b] = ledgerBal
       /\ ledgerBal' = ledgerBal + deposit[b]
       /\ settled' = settled \cup {b}
       /\ leasing' = leasing \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, deposit, live>>

CrashSilently ==
  /\ \E b \in live :
       /\ live' = live \ {b}
       /\ leasing' = leasing \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerBal, settled, snap, deposit>>

Restart ==
  /\ \E b \in Banks \ live :
       live' = live \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ledgerBal, settled, leasing, snap, deposit>>

Next ==
  \/ AcquireLease \/ LeaseExpires \/ Commit \/ CrashSilently \/ Restart

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Banks = {ba, bb}
  MaxDeposit = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
In a bank's interbank settlement batch, several banks contend to update one shared settlement
ledger. Each writer takes out a short-lived lease that snapshots the ledger value it read, and
commits its deposit only if no one else has moved the ledger in the meantime. Leases may expire
and one bank may crash silently mid-batch.

Actions:
- AcquireLease: a live, not-yet-settled bank that holds no lease takes out a lease, snapshotting
  the current ledger balance and fixing the deposit amount it intends to apply.
- LeaseExpires: an outstanding lease times out and is dropped, whether or not the bank committed.
- Commit: a bank holding a lease whose snapshot still matches the current ledger balance applies
  its deposit to the ledger, is marked settled, and releases its lease.
- CrashSilently: any live bank crashes without warning, leaving the live set and dropping any
  lease it held.
- Restart: a crashed bank comes back online and rejoins the live set.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared ledger balance always equals the sum of the deposits of exactly the banks that have settled, so no committed update is ever lost to a stale overwrite.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m1p5t2 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS N

Locks == 0 .. N - 1
Step(i) == (i + 1) % N

VARIABLES tokenHome, tokenGuest, burned, burnLog, doneBy

vars == <<tokenHome, tokenGuest, burned, burnLog, doneBy>>

Seen == { burnLog[i] : i \in DOMAIN burnLog }

TypeOK ==
  /\ tokenHome \in Locks
  /\ tokenGuest \in Locks
  /\ tokenHome # tokenGuest
  /\ burned \subseteq Locks
  /\ burnLog \in Seq(Locks)
  /\ doneBy \in [Locks -> {"none", "home", "guest"}]

\* The one-time key-burn is irreversible: no lock is ever burned twice.
BurnAtMostOnce ==
  \A i, j \in DOMAIN burnLog :
    burnLog[i] = burnLog[j] => i = j

Init ==
  /\ tokenHome = 0
  /\ tokenGuest = 1
  /\ burned = {}
  /\ burnLog = << >>
  /\ doneBy = [k \in Locks |-> "none"]

PassHome ==
  /\ Step(tokenHome) # tokenGuest
  /\ tokenHome' = Step(tokenHome)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenGuest, burned, burnLog, doneBy>>

PassGuest ==
  /\ Step(tokenGuest) # tokenHome
  /\ tokenGuest' = Step(tokenGuest)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenHome, burned, burnLog, doneBy>>

BurnHome ==
  /\ tokenHome \notin Seen
  /\ burned' = burned \cup {tokenHome}
  /\ burnLog' = Append(burnLog, tokenHome)
  /\ doneBy' = [doneBy EXCEPT ![tokenHome] = "home"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenHome, tokenGuest>>

BurnGuest ==
  /\ tokenGuest \notin Seen
  /\ burned' = burned \cup {tokenGuest}
  /\ burnLog' = Append(burnLog, tokenGuest)
  /\ doneBy' = [doneBy EXCEPT ![tokenGuest] = "guest"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenHome, tokenGuest>>

Next == PassHome \/ PassGuest \/ BurnHome \/ BurnGuest

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  N = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT BurnAtMostOnce
nl:
In a smart-home door lock network, the locks are arranged in a ring. Two independent controller
instances -- a home hub and a guest hub -- each circulate their own access token around the same
shared ring of locks, and the two tokens may never rest on the same lock. Holding a token grants
the exclusive right to burn a lock's factory key, an irreversible one-time provisioning step.

Actions:
- PassHome: the home hub's token advances to the next lock in the ring, provided that lock is not
  currently held by the guest token.
- PassGuest: the guest hub's token advances to the next lock in the ring, provided that lock is not
  currently held by the home token.
- BurnHome: the home hub burns the key of the lock its token sits on, but only if that lock has
  never been burned before; the lock is recorded as burned and appended to the burn log.
- BurnGuest: the guest hub burns the key of the lock its token sits on, but only if that lock has
  never been burned before; the lock is recorded as burned and appended to the burn log.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No door lock is ever burned more than once across the entire history of both hubs.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m6p2t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Bays, Cranes, Boxes, LeaseMax

VARIABLES yard, leaseBay, leaseOwner, ttl, aloft

vars == <<yard, leaseBay, leaseOwner, ttl, aloft>>

NoBay == "none"
NoCrane == "idle"

RECURSIVE Piled(_)
Piled(S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET b == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN yard[b] + Piled(S \ {b})

TypeOK ==
  /\ yard \in [Bays -> 0..Boxes]
  /\ leaseBay \in Bays \cup {NoBay}
  /\ leaseOwner \in Cranes \cup {NoCrane}
  /\ ttl \in 0..LeaseMax
  /\ aloft \in 0..Boxes

\* Containers are neither created nor destroyed: those resting in bays plus
\* the one currently hoisted always sum to the fixed yard inventory.
Conserved == Piled(Bays) + aloft = Boxes

Init ==
  /\ yard = [b \in Bays |-> IF b = CHOOSE x \in Bays : TRUE THEN Boxes ELSE 0]
  /\ leaseBay = NoBay
  /\ leaseOwner = NoCrane
  /\ ttl = 0
  /\ aloft = 0

GrantLease ==
  /\ leaseBay = NoBay
  /\ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cranes :
       /\ yard[b] > 0
       /\ leaseBay' = b
       /\ leaseOwner' = c
  /\ ttl' = LeaseMax
  /\ UNCHANGED <<yard, aloft>>

Countdown ==
  /\ ttl > 0
  /\ ttl' = ttl - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<yard, leaseBay, leaseOwner, aloft>>

ExpireLease ==
  /\ ttl = 0
  /\ leaseBay # NoBay
  /\ leaseBay' = NoBay
  /\ leaseOwner' = NoCrane
  /\ UNCHANGED <<yard, ttl, aloft>>

Hoist ==
  /\ leaseBay # NoBay
  /\ ttl > 0
  /\ yard[leaseBay] > 0
  /\ yard' = [yard EXCEPT ![leaseBay] = @ - 1]
  /\ aloft' = aloft + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseBay, leaseOwner, ttl>>

Land ==
  /\ aloft > 0
  /\ \E d \in Bays :
       yard' = [yard EXCEPT ![d] = @ + 1]
  /\ aloft' = aloft - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseBay, leaseOwner, ttl>>

AdminShift ==
  /\ \E s, d \in Bays :
       /\ s # d
       /\ yard[s] > 0
       /\ yard' = [yard EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1, ![d] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseBay, leaseOwner, ttl, aloft>>

Next ==
  \/ GrantLease \/ Countdown \/ ExpireLease \/ Hoist \/ Land \/ AdminShift

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Bays = {q1, q2}
  Cranes = {cx, cy}
  Boxes = 3
  LeaseMax = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
In a container-ship crane yard, containers rest in bays and are shuffled between bays by cranes.
A crane must hold a time-limited lease on a source bay to hoist a container, and a privileged yard
admin can shift containers directly without any lease. Containers are never created or destroyed.

Actions:
- GrantLease: when no lease is outstanding, a crane is granted a lease on some non-empty bay, and
  the lease timer is set to its maximum.
- Countdown: an outstanding lease's timer ticks down by one.
- ExpireLease: once the lease timer reaches zero, the lease is released and the bay is freed.
- Hoist: the crane holding a live lease lifts one container off the leased bay into the air.
- Land: a hoisted container is set down into any bay of the yard.
- AdminShift: the privileged admin moves one container directly from a non-empty bay to a different
  bay, bypassing the leasing protocol entirely.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of containers resting in bays plus the one currently hoisted in the air always equals the fixed total inventory the yard started with.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m1p1t2 -------------------------
EXTENDS Integers

CONSTANTS M

Robots == 0 .. M - 1
Nxt(i) == (i + 1) % M
Weight(i) == i + 1

VARIABLES record, applied, ringP, ringQ, snapP, snapQ

vars == <<record, applied, ringP, ringQ, snapP, snapQ>>

RECURSIVE WSum(_)
WSum(S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET r == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN Weight(r) + WSum(S \ {r})

Top == WSum(Robots)

TypeOK ==
  /\ record \in 0..Top
  /\ applied \subseteq Robots
  /\ ringP \in Robots
  /\ ringQ \in Robots
  /\ ringP # ringQ
  /\ snapP \in -1..Top
  /\ snapQ \in -1..Top

\* The shared record equals the summed weight of exactly the robots that
\* committed: no robot's update was clobbered by a concurrent write.
NoLost == record = WSum(applied)

Init ==
  /\ record = 0
  /\ applied = {}
  /\ ringP = 0
  /\ ringQ = 1
  /\ snapP = -1
  /\ snapQ = -1

RotateP ==
  /\ snapP = -1
  /\ Nxt(ringP) # ringQ
  /\ ringP' = Nxt(ringP)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, applied, ringQ, snapP, snapQ>>

RotateQ ==
  /\ snapQ = -1
  /\ Nxt(ringQ) # ringP
  /\ ringQ' = Nxt(ringQ)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, applied, ringP, snapP, snapQ>>

ReadP ==
  /\ snapP = -1
  /\ ringP \notin applied
  /\ snapP' = record
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, applied, ringP, ringQ, snapQ>>

nl:
In a warehouse robot fleet, robots sit on a ring and share one inventory tally record. Two
independent controller instances each circulate their own access token (P and Q) around the same
ring of robots, so two robots may be attempting updates to the shared record at the same time.
A robot updates the record by reading its value, then writing back its own weight added on, but
only if the record has not moved since it read.

Actions:
- RotateP: token P advances to the next robot on the ring, provided it is not mid-update and the
  next seat is not occupied by token Q.
- RotateQ: token Q advances to the next robot on the ring, provided it is not mid-update and the
  next seat is not occupied by token P.
- ReadP: the robot holding token P, if it has not already committed, snapshots the current record.
- ReadQ: the robot holding token Q, if it has not already committed, snapshots the current record.
- WriteP: the robot holding token P writes its snapshot plus its weight back into the record, but
  only if the record still equals its snapshot; it is then marked committed.
- WriteQ: the robot holding token Q writes its snapshot plus its weight back into the record, but
  only if the record still equals its snapshot; it is then marked committed.
- AbortP: the robot holding token P abandons a pending update whose snapshot is now stale.
- AbortQ: the robot holding token Q abandons a pending update whose snapshot is now stale.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared inventory record always equals the summed weight of exactly the robots that have committed, so no robot's update is ever lost to a concurrent overwrite.

- CasClaim: a flight with a pending target compare-and-swaps the slot from free to itself, provided

- CasFail: a flight whose targeted slot is no longer free or has fallen outside capacity abandons

  MaxCap = 3
  MaxReq = 2

nl:
In a bank's interbank settlement batch, banks book slots in a shared batch whose total ceiling is
reconfigured at runtime. Banks reserve slots through a compare-and-swap against a shared fill
register: a bank reads the register, then swaps in its addition only if the register has not moved
and the batch ceiling would not be exceeded. The invariant of interest is the literal capacity
bound, so it is stated directly.

Actions:
- Prepare: a bank with no pending request picks an amount of slots to book and snapshots the
  current fill register.
- CasCommit: a bank with a pending request commits it, but only if the register still equals its
  snapshot and the addition keeps the total within the current ceiling; the register and the bank's
  booking both advance.
- CasRetry: a bank whose snapshot no longer matches the register abandons its pending request.
- Settle: a bank releases one of its booked slots, decrementing both its booking and the register.
- GrowCeiling: the batch ceiling is raised at runtime.
- ShrinkCeiling: the batch ceiling is lowered at runtime, but never below the slots already booked.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of slots booked across all banks never exceeds the current batch ceiling.

nl:
In a multiplayer game lobby matchmaker, a fixed population of players is spread between a waiting
lounge and a set of lobbies. The matchmaker periodically reconfigures under a new epoch number,
and the per-lobby seat capacity can change at runtime with each reconfiguration. A migration that
was started under an old epoch is considered stale after a reconfiguration.

Actions:
- TakeSeat: a player waiting in the lounge sits down in a lobby that still has room under the
  current capacity.
- Leave: a seated player stands up and returns to the lounge.
- StartMigrate: while no migration is in flight, a seated player is lifted out of its lobby into a
  migration tagged with the current epoch and a destination lobby.
- Reconfigure: the matchmaker advances the epoch and picks a new per-lobby seat capacity.
- DeliverMigrate: an in-flight migration still tagged with the current epoch lands its player in
  the destination lobby, provided that lobby has room.
- RejectStale: an in-flight migration whose epoch tag no longer matches the current epoch is
  rejected, returning its player to the lounge.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of players waiting in the lounge, seated across all lobbies, and possibly mid-migration always sums to the fixed player population.

  /\ chair \in Coordinators \cup {NIL}
  /\ standing \subseteq Coordinators
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

\* same slot is never allocated to two different orders.

  /\ heldBy = [o \in Orders |-> NIL]
  /\ chair = NIL
  /\ standing = Coordinators
  /\ term = 0

  /\ chair = NIL
  /\ \E c \in standing :
       /\ chair' = c
       /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, heldBy, standing>>

ChairFails ==
  /\ chair # NIL
  /\ standing' = standing \ {chair}
  /\ chair' = NIL
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, heldBy, term>>

Rejoin ==
  /\ \E c \in Coordinators \ standing :
       standing' = standing \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, heldBy, chair, term>>

  /\ chair # NIL
  /\ \E o \in Orders, s \in Slots :
       /\ heldBy[o] = NIL
       /\ owner[s] = FREE
       /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = o]
       /\ heldBy' = [heldBy EXCEPT ![o] = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<chair, standing, term>>

       /\ heldBy[o] = NIL
       /\ owner[s] = FREE
       /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = o]
       /\ heldBy' = [heldBy EXCEPT ![o] = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<chair, standing, term>>

       /\ heldBy[o] # NIL
       /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![heldBy[o]] = FREE]

  \/ Allocate \/ AdminAllocate \/ Withdraw

nl:
In a stock exchange opening auction, a coordinator allocates price-time slots to orders. The
coordinator role is filled by leader election with failover, and a privileged admin can allocate
slots directly. A slot may be granted to at most one order.

Actions:
- Elect: when the chair seat is vacant, a standing coordinator is elected chair and the term
  counter advances, saturating at its cap.
- ChairFails: the current chair fails, dropping out of the standing set and leaving the chair vacant.
- Rejoin: a coordinator that had failed rejoins the standing set.
- Allocate: the current chair grants a free slot to an order that holds none, recording the order
  as the slot's owner and the slot as the order's holding.
- AdminAllocate: the privileged admin grants a free slot to an order that holds none, bypassing the
  chair but still respecting that the slot must be free.
- Withdraw: an order releases the slot it holds, freeing that slot.

In a hospital operating-room scheduler, a fixed budget of operating-room hour tokens is claimed by
surgeons from a shared pool through a compare-and-swap register. A surgeon may crash silently at
any time, abandoning whatever claim it had in progress. Tokens are never created or destroyed.

Actions:
- ReadPool: a live surgeon with no pending claim snapshots the current free pool value.
- CasReserve: a surgeon whose snapshot still matches the pool takes one token out of the pool into
  its reserved bucket.
- CasAbort: a surgeon whose snapshot no longer matches the pool discards its pending claim.
- Confirm: a surgeon converts one reserved token into a booked operating-room hour.
- Release: a surgeon gives back one booked hour, returning that token to the free pool.
- CrashSilently: any live surgeon crashes without warning, leaving the live set and dropping any
  pending claim it held.
- Restart: a crashed surgeon comes back online and rejoins the live set.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The free pool, the tokens reserved mid-claim, and the tokens already booked always sum to the fixed operating-room hour budget.

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Stations, Prios, Cap

IDLE == "idle"

VARIABLES backlog, serving, phase, pace

vars == <<backlog, serving, phase, pace>>

Busy == { st \in Stations : serving[st] # IDLE }
Occupancy == Len(backlog) + Cardinality(Busy)

TypeOK ==
  /\ backlog \in Seq(Prios)
  /\ serving \in [Stations -> Prios \cup {IDLE}]
  /\ phase \in [Stations -> {"idle", "filling", "ready"}]
  /\ pace \in [Stations -> {"fast", "slow"}]

\* The number of prescriptions in the system -- waiting in the bounded backlog
\* plus those being filled at stations -- never exceeds the queue capacity.
Bounded == Occupancy <= Cap

Init ==
  /\ backlog = << >>
  /\ serving = [st \in Stations |-> IDLE]
  /\ phase = [st \in Stations |-> "idle"]
  /\ pace = [st \in Stations |-> "fast"]

Admit ==
  /\ Occupancy < Cap
  /\ \E p \in Prios :
       backlog' = Append(backlog, p)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serving, phase, pace>>

Pull ==
  /\ \E st \in Stations :
       /\ serving[st] = IDLE
       /\ backlog # << >>
       /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![st] = Head(backlog)]
       /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![st] = "filling"]
       /\ backlog' = Tail(backlog)
  /\ UNCHANGED pace

SlowStep ==
  /\ \E st \in Stations :
       /\ pace[st] = "slow"
       /\ phase[st] = "filling"
       /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![st] = "ready"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<backlog, serving, pace>>

DispenseFast ==
  /\ \E st \in Stations :
       /\ pace[st] = "fast"
       /\ phase[st] = "filling"
       /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![st] = IDLE]
       /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![st] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<backlog, pace>>

DispenseSlow ==
  /\ \E st \in Stations :
       /\ pace[st] = "slow"
       /\ phase[st] = "ready"
       /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![st] = IDLE]
       /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![st] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<backlog, pace>>

SetPace ==
  /\ \E st \in Stations, m \in {"fast", "slow"} :
       pace' = [pace EXCEPT ![st] = m]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<backlog, serving, phase>>

Next ==
  \/ Admit \/ Pull \/ SlowStep
  \/ DispenseFast \/ DispenseSlow \/ SetPace

nl:
In a pharmacy prescription dispenser network, incoming prescriptions wait in a bounded backlog and
are filled at dispensing stations. Backpressure keeps the total load capped. A station may be slow
but is never failed: a slow station needs an extra filling step before it can dispense, and a
station's pace can change over time.

Actions:
- Admit: a new prescription of some priority joins the backlog, but only while the total number in
  the system is below capacity, applying backpressure when full.
- Pull: an idle station takes the head prescription off the backlog and begins filling it.
- SlowStep: a slow station that is filling advances the prescription to the ready state.
- DispenseFast: a fast station that is filling dispenses immediately and becomes idle.
- DispenseSlow: a slow station whose prescription is ready dispenses it and becomes idle.
- SetPace: any station switches its pace between fast and slow; it is never taken out of service.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of prescriptions in the system -- waiting in the backlog plus those being filled at stations -- never exceeds the queue capacity.

       /\ holder[m.sec] = m.dr

       /\ watching' = [watching EXCEPT ![m.dr] = NIL]
       /\ releases' = releases \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED gen

  /\ \E m \in releases :
       /\ holder[m.sec] # m.dr
       /\ releases' = releases \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, gen, watching>>

sector is watched by at most one drone. Leases expire, and release messages travel over a network
that can reorder and delay them, so a stale release may arrive after the sector has been re-leased.

  generation advances, saturating at its cap.

- ApplyRelease: a pending release message whose sending drone is still the sector's current holder

- DiscardStale: a pending release message whose sending drone is no longer the sector's holder
  (the sector was re-leased in the meantime) is recognized as stale and discarded without freeing.
- ForceExpire: a sector's lease times out directly, freeing the sector and clearing its holder's
  watch.

only if the record has not moved since it read it. One party may crash silently at any time.

Actions:
- Propose: a live party with no active proposal reads the current record and opens a proposal,
  casting its own vote for it.
- CastVote: a live party that has not yet voted casts its vote for some party's open proposal.
- Commit: a party whose open proposal has gathered a quorum of votes and whose read value still
  equals the current record applies its weighted update, is marked applied, and its votes are cleared.
- Abandon: a party whose proposal's read value no longer matches the record abandons the proposal,
  clearing its votes.
- CrashSilently: any live party crashes without warning, leaving the live set, dropping its own
  proposal, and withdrawing every vote it had cast.
- Restart: a crashed party comes back online and rejoins the live set.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared schedule record always equals the summed weight of exactly the parties whose quorum-approved updates committed, so no committed update is ever lost to a concurrent overwrite.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m2p0t4 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines

NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, inLane, phase, votes, proposer, active

vars == <<owner, inLane, phase, votes, proposer, active>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in Machines \cup {NONE}
  /\ inLane \subseteq Machines
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "granted"}
  /\ votes \in [Machines -> {"blank", "yes"}]
  /\ proposer \in Machines \cup {NONE}
  /\ active \subseteq Machines

\* Any machine executing in the dispensing lane is the sole current owner:
\* at most one machine is ever in the critical lane at a time.
MutEx == \A m \in inLane : owner = m

Init ==
  /\ owner = NONE
  /\ inLane = {}
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ votes = [m \in Machines |-> "blank"]
  /\ proposer = NONE
  /\ active = Machines

Request ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ owner = NONE
  /\ \E m \in Machines :
       /\ proposer' = m
       /\ votes' = [x \in Machines |-> "blank"]
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, inLane, active>>

Vote ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \E v \in active :
       /\ votes[v] = "blank"
       /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![v] = "yes"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, inLane, phase, proposer, active>>

CommitGrant ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \A a \in active : votes[a] = "yes"
  /\ owner' = proposer
  /\ phase' = "granted"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inLane, votes, proposer, active>>

AbortGrant ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ proposer' = NONE
  /\ votes' = [m \in Machines |-> "blank"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, inLane, active>>

Enter ==
  /\ \E m \in Machines :
       /\ owner = m
       /\ m \notin inLane
       /\ inLane' = inLane \cup {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, phase, votes, proposer, active>>

Release ==
  /\ \E m \in Machines :
       /\ owner = m
       /\ owner' = NONE
       /\ inLane' = inLane \ {m}
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ proposer' = NONE
  /\ votes' = [x \in Machines |-> "blank"]
  /\ UNCHANGED active

Reconfigure ==
  /\ \/ \E m \in Machines \ active : active' = active \cup {m}
     \/ \E m \in active : active' = active \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, inLane, phase, votes, proposer>>

Next ==
  \/ Request \/ Vote \/ CommitGrant \/ AbortGrant
  \/ Enter \/ Release \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

  Machines = {v1, v2}
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT MutEx
nl:
In a vending machine network, machines contend for a single shared dispensing lane, which is a
critical resource. Access is granted through two-phase commit across the currently active
participants: a machine proposes, the active participants vote, and only a unanimous prepare lets
the grant commit. The set of active participants is reconfigured at runtime.

Actions:
- Request: while the lane is free and the coordinator idle, a machine opens a grant proposal and
  the voting phase begins with all ballots blanked.
- Vote: an active participant casts a yes ballot for the open proposal.
- CommitGrant: when every active participant has voted yes, the proposal commits and the proposing
  machine becomes the lane owner.
- AbortGrant: the coordinator aborts the current proposal, returning to idle with ballots cleared.
- Enter: the lane owner enters the critical dispensing lane.
- Release: the lane owner exits the lane, freeing it and returning the coordinator to idle.
- Reconfigure: the set of active participants is changed at runtime by adding or removing a machine.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one machine is ever executing in the shared dispensing lane at a time, and it is always the current lane owner.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m6p5t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Jobs, Workers, MaxTtl

FREE == "free"

VARIABLES holder, ttl, printLog, reqs

vars == <<holder, ttl, printLog, reqs>>

ReqSpace == [job : Jobs, w : Workers]
Printed == { printLog[i] : i \in DOMAIN printLog }

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in [Jobs -> Workers \cup {FREE}]
  /\ ttl \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxTtl]
  /\ printLog \in Seq(Jobs)
  /\ reqs \subseteq ReqSpace

\* Printing a job is irreversible: no job appears more than once in the
\* print log, so no job is ever printed twice.
PrintOnce ==
  \A i, j \in DOMAIN printLog :
    printLog[i] = printLog[j] => i = j

Init ==
  /\ holder = [j \in Jobs |-> FREE]
  /\ ttl = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
  /\ printLog = << >>
  /\ reqs = {}

Lease ==
  /\ \E w \in Workers, j \in Jobs :
       /\ holder[j] = FREE
       /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![j] = w]
       /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![j] = MaxTtl]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<printLog, reqs>>

Tick ==
  /\ \E j \in Jobs :
       /\ ttl[j] > 0
       /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![j] = @ - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, printLog, reqs>>

Expire ==
  /\ \E j \in Jobs :
       /\ ttl[j] = 0
       /\ holder[j] # FREE
       /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![j] = FREE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, printLog, reqs>>

SubmitPrint ==
  /\ \E w \in Workers, j \in Jobs :
       /\ holder[j] = w
       /\ ttl[j] > 0
       /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {[job |-> j, w |-> w]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, ttl, printLog>>

ApplyPrint ==
  /\ \E r \in reqs :
       /\ r.job \notin Printed
       /\ printLog' = Append(printLog, r.job)
       /\ reqs' = reqs \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, ttl>>

DropReq ==
  /\ \E r \in reqs :
       /\ r.job \in Printed
       /\ reqs' = reqs \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, ttl, printLog>>

Next ==
  \/ Lease \/ Tick \/ Expire \/ SubmitPrint \/ ApplyPrint \/ DropReq

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================
nl:
In a print shop job spooler, worker processes lease print jobs to print them. A lease has a limited
time to live and then expires. Actually printing a job is irreversible and must happen at most once.
Print-request messages travel over a channel that can reorder and delay them, so a stale request may
still be pending after a job has already been printed.

Actions:
- Lease: a worker takes out a lease on a currently unleased job, setting the lease timer to its max.
- Tick: an outstanding lease's timer ticks down by one.
- Expire: a lease whose timer has reached zero is released, freeing the job to be leased again.
- SubmitPrint: a worker holding a live lease on a job submits a print request for it, which joins
  the reorderable set of pending requests.
- ApplyPrint: a pending print request for a job that has not yet been printed is carried out,
  appending the job to the irreversible print log and removing the request.
- DropReq: a pending print request for a job that has already been printed is recognized as stale
  and discarded.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No print job ever appears more than once in the irreversible print log, so no job is ever printed twice.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m3p2t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Doors, Hubs, Keys, MaxTerm

NOHUB == "nohub"

VARIABLES vault, pouch, leadHub, powered, term

vars == <<vault, pouch, leadHub, powered, term>>

RECURSIVE Held(_)
Held(S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET d == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN vault[d] + Held(S \ {d})

TypeOK ==
  /\ vault \in [Doors -> 0..Keys]
  /\ pouch \in 0..Keys
  /\ leadHub \in Hubs \cup {NOHUB}
  /\ powered \subseteq Hubs
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

\* Digital keys are conserved: those provisioned into door locks plus those
\* still in the lead hub's undistributed pouch always sum to the fixed keyset.
Conserved == pouch + Held(Doors) = Keys

Init ==
  /\ vault = [d \in Doors |-> 0]
  /\ pouch = Keys
  /\ leadHub = NOHUB
  /\ powered = Hubs
  /\ term = 0

Elect ==
  /\ leadHub = NOHUB
  /\ \E h \in powered :
       /\ leadHub' = h
       /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, pouch, powered>>

HubFails ==
  /\ leadHub # NOHUB
  /\ powered' = powered \ {leadHub}
  /\ leadHub' = NOHUB
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, pouch, term>>

HubRecovers ==
  /\ \E h \in Hubs \ powered :
       powered' = powered \cup {h}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, pouch, leadHub, term>>

Provision ==
  /\ leadHub # NOHUB
  /\ pouch > 0
  /\ \E d \in Doors :
       vault' = [vault EXCEPT ![d] = @ + 1]
  /\ pouch' = pouch - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leadHub, powered, term>>

Revoke ==
  /\ leadHub # NOHUB
  /\ \E d \in Doors :
       /\ vault[d] > 0
       /\ vault' = [vault EXCEPT ![d] = @ - 1]
  /\ pouch' = pouch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leadHub, powered, term>>

AdminMove ==
  /\ \E s, d \in Doors :
       /\ s # d
       /\ vault[s] > 0
       /\ vault' = [vault EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1, ![d] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pouch, leadHub, powered, term>>

Next ==
  \/ Elect \/ HubFails \/ HubRecovers \/ Provision \/ Revoke \/ AdminMove

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  Doors = {da, db}
  Hubs = {h1, h2}
  Keys = 2
  MaxTerm = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
In a smart-home door lock network, a lead hub provisions a fixed set of digital keys into door
locks. The lead hub role is filled by leader election with failover, and a privileged admin can
move keys directly between doors. Keys are never created or destroyed.

Actions:
- Elect: when there is no lead hub, a powered hub is elected lead and the term counter advances,
  saturating at its cap.
- HubFails: the current lead hub loses power, dropping out of the powered set and leaving the lead
  role vacant so a new election can occur.
- HubRecovers: a hub that had lost power is restored to the powered set.
- Provision: the lead hub moves one key out of its undistributed pouch into some door lock.
- Revoke: the lead hub pulls one key back out of a door lock into its pouch.
- AdminMove: the privileged admin moves one key directly from one door lock to a different door
  lock, bypassing the lead hub.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The keys provisioned across all door locks plus those still in the lead hub's pouch always sum to the fixed number of digital keys the network started with.
